headline: Etsy marketplace GMS turned barely positive (+0.1%) in holiday Q4 as buyers kept shrinking; Etsy agreed to sell Depop to eBay for $1.2bn.
guidance_note: Q1 2026 GMS guided to $2.38-2.43bn; FY 2026 expected to show slight YoY GMS growth with gains in every quarter; take rate ~25.5%.
key_messages: Etsy marketplace GMS +0.1% YoY, its first positive comparison since Q3 2023, but -1% FX-neutral. Consolidated GMS $3.59bn (-3.8%; +2.4% ex-Reverb).
Active buyers 86.5m (TTM), -3.4% YoY and flat versus Q3; habitual buyers reportedly -8.6% YoY and purchase frequency still below last year.
App GMS growth sped up to +6.6%, app about 46% of GMS; agentic/AI-referred traffic up ~15x but under 1% of total.
Depop (Q4 GMS ~$300m, +38%) to be sold to eBay for $1.2bn in cash; Kruti Patel Goyal's first call as CEO.

consumer.big_ticket: Holiday-quarter discretionary GMS was flat ex-FX, with fewer buyers and fewer habitual buyers.

macro_read: Flat holiday GMS and a shrinking buyer base at a discretionary gift marketplace point to cautious, selective goods spending in late 2025.
notes: Consolidated GMS fell 3.8% as reported, or rose 2.4% excluding Reverb, which was sold in 2025.
Etsy reports GAAP only; the EPS shown is GAAP diluted EPS ($0.92). Net income of $110.7m was down YoY mainly because Q4 2024 included a non-cash FX gain.
Reverb was sold in mid-2025, so reported revenue (+3.5%) and GMS (-3.8%) understate the underlying trend (+6.6% revenue and +2.4% GMS ex-Reverb). Q4 2025 figures still include Depop.
EPS consensus left null: sources cited $0.84 and $0.85. Revenue consensus ($885m) is from secondary coverage; some outlets called revenue in line.
Stock reaction left null: sources conflict (+21.4% pre-market/early, 'more than 11%', +9.3%, +8.39% on the following day).
Habitual-buyer decline (-8.6%) comes from secondary call summaries.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: Etsy shares surge on Depop sale
